metadata.title: Palantir earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts

content.text:
Investing.com -- Palantir Technologies (PLTR) beat on the Q3 FY2026 report (Nov 2, 2026), but the stock still fell. It traded at $173.74 (-2.58%) as of Nov 3, 12:49 PM EST. The market is now debating how long the growth lasts and what it costs, not whether the growth is real.
Palantir Technologies (PLTR): $173.74 || 1W: -12.63% || 52W range $106.37–$212.94 || P/E 114.7x (Sep 30, 2026) || Fair Value $153.69 (-11.6% upside, Nov 3, 2026)
Questions Answered
-
Does growth keep accelerating? Yes. Revenue was $2.31B vs $2.17B est, up 95.9% YoY. That is the 13th straight quarter of acceleration, from 48% in Q2 2025. EPS was $0.44 vs $0.41 est. Baird (Nov 3, 2026)
-
Is commercial the new engine? Yes. U.S. commercial revenue rose 148% to $984M and passed U.S. government revenue ($953M, +96%) for the first time. Navellier analysis (Nov 3, 2026)
-
Does it scale profitably? Yes. Adjusted operating margin was 61.7% against a 60.2% consensus. Net dollar retention rose 8 points to 165%. StoneX (Nov 3, 2026)
-
Will guidance rise? Yes. The 2026 revenue outlook went up about $378M to $8.53B, or roughly 91% growth, from a prior 82%.
Questions Still Open
-
Bookings lag revenue. Total contract value signed was $2.92B, up only 6% YoY. Revenue is up 96%, so backlog is being consumed faster than it is refilled.
-
RPO flat. Remaining performance obligations were flat sequentially. Palantir says sovereign AI deals are being signed under 12 months, so they don't appear in the metric. UBS (Nov 3, 2026)
-
Customer adds slowed. U.S. commercial sequential additions were 33.
-
Valuation. Analysts' targets range from RBC's $130 (Underperform) to Baird's $250 and Mizuho's $245 (both Outperform). The stock sits above the $153.69 fair value estimate.
Next Catalysts
-
Q4 FY2026 report, tentatively Feb 17, 2027. Consensus is EPS $0.46 and revenue $2.46B. Palantir has beaten revenue in each of the last six quarters, but the stock fell after three of them.
-
Bookings rebound. Management previously saw a weak Q1 followed by recovery in Q2. Another rebound in contract value would ease the backlog worry.
-
Sovereign AI conversion. The question is whether the short contracts become larger, longer ones.
-
Estimate path. Consensus revenue for FY2027 is $12.39B, versus $8.21B for FY2026. UBS lifted its 2027 growth forecast to 70%. Estimates have barely moved in the past 30 days (-0.92% for EPS).
-
Sentiment. The stock is down 12.6% over the past week but up 38% over three months.
